sql:
SELECT
  t.name AS merchant_name,
  t.industry,
  t.status,
  MAX(o.placed_at)::date AS last_order_date,
  (DATE '2026-01-05' - MAX(o.placed_at)::date) AS days_since_last_order,
  COUNT(*) AS lifetime_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(o.grand_total / er.rate), 2) AS lifetime_revenue_eur
FROM tenants t
JOIN orders o
  ON o.tenant_id = t.id
 AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
 AND o.placed_at IS NOT NULL
JOIN exchange_rates er
  ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
 AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
 AND er.as_of = o.placed_at::date
WHERE t.status <> 'churned'
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.industry, t.status
HAVING MAX(o.placed_at) < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-09'
   AND COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY lifetime_revenue_eur DESC, t.id
LIMIT 50
note: One row per non-churned tenant meeting the silent-churn criteria (last order before 2025-07-09, >=20 lifetime orders, excluding cancelled orders), ranked by lifetime EUR revenue; report will note the total row count returned beyond the 50-row cap.
